Kadafa, who hailed from Hong Local Government Area of Adamawa State, was abducted at Audi Janguan Village, beyond Olam Farm along the Abuja-Kaduna Expressway.
His lifeless body has since been recovered, with his burial scheduled for Saturday, November 21, 2026, in Kaduna.
A family member, who requested anonymity, said the family felt betrayed by the abductors, accusing them of collecting the ransom demanded for his release before killing him.
The family also expressed disappointment with security agencies, blaming them for failing to secure Kadafa’s release despite the reported payment of the ransom.
In a related development, unconfirmed reports indicate that Kadafa’s friend, Mustapha Shelpidi, was murdered by the same assailants three days before the farmer’s body was recovered.
The latest development comes days after LEADERSHIP reported that Kadafa had been killed despite the reported payment of N56 million ransom.
The incident has renewed concerns over insecurity along the Abuja-Kaduna Expressway, where bandit attacks continue to threaten farmers, commuters and residents of surrounding communities.
The killing also comes amid the ongoing harvest season, when farmers across the country are gathering their farm produce.
